item.title: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation launched strikes with unmanned aerial vehicles against transport infrastructure and defence industry facilities, as well a
item.description: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation launched strikes with unmanned aerial vehicles against transport infrastructure and defence industry facilities, as well as vessels used in the interests of the AFU. 💥 As a result of the strikes, the following targets were hit: ▪️ a 330 kV power substation in Zaporozhye , which provides support for Ukrainian defence industry enterprises; ▪️ two railway locomotives in Dnepropetrovsk transporting weapons and military hardware; ▪️ a 330 kV power substation in Zelenodolsk of Dnepropetrovsk region supporting the operation of Ukrainian defence industry enterprises; ▪️ an industrial enterprise in the village of Snovsk in Chernigov region , where UAV components were produced; ▪️ a dry cargo ship in the Chernomorsk port, which delivered military cargo to Ukraine. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30774

❗️
Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation launched strikes
with unmanned aerial vehicles against transport infrastructure and defence industry facilities, as well as vessels used in the interests of the AFU.
💥
As a result of the strikes, the following targets
were hit:
▪️
a 330 kV power substation in Zaporozhye
, which provides support for Ukrainian defence industry enterprises;
▪️
two railway locomotives
in Dnepropetrovsk transporting weapons and military hardware;
▪️
a 330 kV power substation in Zelenodolsk of Dnepropetrovsk region
supporting the operation of Ukrainian defence industry enterprises;
▪️
an industrial enterprise in the village of Snovsk in Chernigov region
, where UAV components were produced;
▪️
a dry cargo ship in the Chernomorsk port,
which delivered military cargo to Ukraine.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ Today, during the daytime, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation delivered UAV strikes at
item.description: ❗️ Today, during the daytime, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation delivered UAV strikes at power infrastructure facilities, as well as vessels used in the interests of the AFU. 💥 As a result of the strike, the following targets were hit: three 110 kV power substations providing operation of defence industry facilities of Ukraine in Vinnitsa, in Obolonye (Chernigov region) and Rakitnoye (Rovno region). 🔥 In addition, a dry cargo ship delivering dual-use cargo to support the AFU was hit at sea in the Black Sea waters south-west of Odessa. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30767

❗️
Today, during the daytime, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation delivered UAV strikes at
power infrastructure facilities, as well as vessels used in the interests of the AFU.
💥
As a result of the strike, the following targets were hit:
three 110 kV power substations providing operation of defence industry facilities of Ukraine in Vinnitsa, in Obolonye (Chernigov region) and Rakitnoye (Rovno region).
🔥
In addition,
a dry cargo ship
delivering dual-use cargo to support the AFU
was hit at sea in the Black Sea waters south-west of Odessa.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
